title: Israel has committed genocide in Gaza, concludes UN commission of inquiry - latest updates
summary: Finding comes as Israel’s defence minister says ‘Gaza is burning’ amid escalation in bombardment See all our Israel-Gaza war coverage Wafa, the Palestinian news agency, has been told by medical sources that at least 38 Palestinian people, including women and children, have been killed by Israeli forces since dawn today.
